original: The WPRPLACE is the remnant of an old creek that was located between the Hotte and the Veerse Diep in the Netherlands. Today it is located near the village of Kwadendamme.
translated: Der WPRPLACE ist der Überrest eines alten Baches, der zwischen der Hotte und der Veerse Diep in den Niederlanden lag. Heute liegt es in der Nähe des Dorfes Kwadendamme.
